notes.title: 🎉 Major Update for Dungeon Bomb 2.0.0 is Here! 💣
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone[/b]
We’re excited to introduce the long-awaited online multiplayer mode! 🎮
Now you can blast your friends anytime, anywhere—no matter the distance!
🔥 Adding UI Mouse control
🔥 Reskin all character
🔥 Plus, say hello to a brand-new character from the game Holiday Farm, joining the chaos with their own unique flair!

📌 This update also includes performance improvements and overall gameplay enhancements.

Thank you for all your support—and see you in the arena! ❤️
